h: Every card leaves here in the same build. 📦
t: Penny sleeve. Semi-rigid card saver — not a top loader. Team bag. Mailer. Top loaders are for 20 bucks and up, in a bubble mailer with cardboard. Everything else rides the same…

h: The Pokédex chase has rules, and they're stricter than you'd think. 🎴
t: 980 of 1,025 species. 45 to go. One card per species, and the printed name has to be ONLY the species name. Regional forms don't fill the slot. A card named after a trainer…

h: I wrote down every lesson from fixing the store. 18 of them. 📝
t: Weeks of going listing by listing, finding every way a store can quietly lie to itself — the record says fixed, the buyer page says otherwise. So the lessons are written down now.…

h: eBay took the one sort I actually used. 😤
t: The views column used to click-to-sort. Most viewed first, that's how I like to see my store — what's moving, what people are actually hunting. Two days ago it worked. Now the…

h: Binder or box — how do you store your bulk? 🗂️
t: I've got boxes with rows, groups of 50, color-coded tabs. Looks like chaos, pulls like a map. Binders are pretty. Boxes are fast. And when you're hunting one card out of…

h: I build things all day. Then I come home and build this. 🔨
t: At work they call me a dream maker — somebody dreams it up, I make it happen in the field. Same hands, different desk at night. Cards instead of steel, sort table instead of a job…
